name: zoth-netlify-ax-expert
description: Sovereign Netlify Build Auditor, Diagnoser, and Autonomous Self-Healing MCP Server

tools.name: netlify_audit
tools.description: Performs full 14-point AST audit of Netlify build configuration, redirects, and assets.

tools.name: netlify_self_heal
tools.description: Autonomously heals case mismatches, circular redirects, missing SPA fallbacks, and security headers.

tools.name: netlify_diagnose_log
tools.description: Diagnoses raw build failure log text and generates deterministic code patches.

tools.name: netlify_generate_config
tools.description: Generates production-grade netlify.toml for a specific framework (static, nextjs, vite_react, astro, svelte, nuxt).
